responsibility: Declares the Rust metadata import subsystem’s core abstractions for locating and reading external crate interface data. It defines the search-path entry point, the Import facade used by later readers, the polymorphic Import::Stream API with position and error tracking plus byte-matching helpers for parsers, and the concrete stream types for string, malloc-owned buffer, and file-descriptor sources, along with the private package/object/archive discovery hooks used by the implementation.
same_name_distinction: Defines the import subsystem’s public abstractions—Import, the nested Stream interface, and concrete string/buffer/file stream classes—plus the package-opening and helper function declarations. Unlike the .cc peer, it describes the API and stream class structure but does not implement search-path resolution, file probing, or export-data extraction.
